headline: Front Lines Stir Across Six Strategic Sectors
war_summary: The latest watch shows the fighting shifting rather than settling. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ledger, with 55 strategic-base events and four in the newest two hours; its holdings stand divided, four Warden and four Colonial, with one base neutral. Stlican Shelf records 36 events, five in two hours, and remains evenly split at four apiece with one neutral. Godcrofts has quickened sharply since the previous edition, reaching 28 events and six in the latest two hours, while its Colonial majority stands at eight bases to one. Stonecradle has also edged upward to 28 events, including three recent movements, with Wardens holding six bases against three Colonial. Linn Mercy retains a divided six-to-five Warden lead and 27 events overall, but no movement appears in the newest two-hour window after seven events in six hours. Elsewhere, Callahan’s Passage is a furious late entrant: five events in 24 hours, two just recorded, alongside sharply accelerating casualties and enlistments. Viper Pit likewise shows renewed pressure, with nine events and two recent movements. Quiet sectors remain numerous, and no victor is declared.
